page_title: PSG 0-0 LOR | PSG v Lorient 12/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Manuel Ugarte (Paris SG) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post.
90+4' Paris SG are seeing far more of the ball now.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' A lofted cross from Danilo Pereira (Paris SG) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
89' The Paris SG players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
86' Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
85' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
82' Substitution. Lucas Hernandez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Marquinhos (Paris SG).
82' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Hugo Ekitike (Paris SG) replaces Kang-In Lee.
81' Romain Faivre (Lorient) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
79' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Vincent Le Goff as he is replaced by Darlin Yongwa (Lorient).
79' Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
78' Paris SG fail to score from a corner as Yvon Mvogo (Lorient) leaps to collect the ball.
77' Carlos Soler (Paris SG) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Paris SG will have a corner.
77' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG) inside the box.
74' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
74' Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
72' Carlos Soler (Paris SG) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in.
72' Half-chance! Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG) plays a pass into the box, but Yvon Mvogo reacts well to snuff out the attack.
71' Lorient have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
70' Romain Faivre (Lorient) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Corner kick. Lorient will have an opportunity.
70' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
69' The corner is swung in but Paris SG can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
69' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Marco Asensio and he is replaced by Carlos Soler (Paris SG).
68' Substitution. Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG) has come on for Vitinha.
65' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
61' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
60' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Paris SG are awarded a free kick.
59' Regis Le Bris has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Julien Ponceau (Lorient) replacing Jean-Victor Makengo.
59' The substitution is prepared. Ibrahima Kone (Lorient) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Bamba Dieng.
58' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lorient comes to nothing.

57' Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. Lorient force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
56' Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yvon Mvogo, who smothers the ball.
54' Marco Asensio (Paris SG) sends a cross into the box, but Yvon Mvogo comes off his line to gather the ball.
53' Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
52' That was close by Vitinha (Paris SG)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
51' A cross from Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
51' Lorient are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
49' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
47' The corner kick picks out Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
47' It will be a corner kick for Paris SG.
47' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
46' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' The resulting set piece from Paris SG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

45' The resulting free kick from 28 metres out taken by Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) was blocked by the defensive wall, which was perfectly positioned by the goalkeeper. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Paris SG.
44' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Paris SG.
44' Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) was too forceful with his tackle and Bastien Dechepy interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
42' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the right post. Aim better, sir.
41' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle as Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
40' Paris SG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
36' Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) volleys the ball from just outside the box, but his effort goes narrowly over the bar.
36' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kang-In Lee (Paris SG).
35' Marco Asensio (Paris SG) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
34' Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
31' Vitinha (Paris SG) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
29' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) jumps into a tackle and Bastien Dechepy signals a foul.
27' Lorient are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
25' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
24' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
21' A corner kick by Paris SG is thwarted by the well prepared Yvon Mvogo (Lorient).
21' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball is out of play. Paris SG will have a chance to score from a corner.
18' A quickly taken corner by Paris SG.
16' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
13' Manuel Ugarte (Paris SG) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
11' Paris SG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
8' Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG) volleys the ball towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his shot by pulling off a wonderful save.
4' Some great controlled play and passing from Paris SG. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
2' Paris SG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Paris SG will have the kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy is introduced as the referee for today's match.
